metadata.title: BERTopic for R 0.1.2: validated Windows software and analysis materials
metadata.description: Corrected R interface, exact source archive, five paired fresh-process R/Python runs, full SMS worked example, resolved Windows environment, raw outputs, figures and manuscript. BERTopic 0.16.0 / Python 3.10.21 only. Historical SMS ham-selection reconstruction (E) is deferred; this archive preserves the actual packaged input and its hash.
